description: This file defines constant string values and utility methods used throughout the Credentials API in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes field names, secret types, hash functions, API actions, and methods for constructing search criteria and request messages in JSON format.

classes.name: CredentialsConstants
classes.description: A final utility class containing constant definitions and static methods for handling credential-related data, including search criteria, request construction, and secret property extraction. It also contains an enum for credential actions.

methods.name: getSearchCriteria
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with search criteria for credentials based on type and authId.

methods.name: getServiceGetRequestAsJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON object representing a request message for retrieving credentials, including tenant, device ID, auth ID, and type.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the hash function used for a hashed-password secret, defaulting to SHA-256 if not specified.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Extracts the password hash from a secret JSON object, throws if missing.

methods.name: getPasswordSalt
methods.description: Retrieves the salt value from a secret JSON object, or null if not present.
